confidence_notes: Recent city and Japan cost-of-living prices support the meal, coffee, and beer estimates, though beer and coffee figures vary across sources. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical price relationship to local beer. Accommodation is a holistic July estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Matsuyama is treated as a midsized regional Japanese city, with accommodation estimates reflecting regional-city prices and Dogo Onsen tourism demand.
